items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Pearson' as a member of the 'Sunny South' band but does not describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with Eddie Pearson specifically; the interviewer identifies Eddie Pearson in a different context (O'Day-Jean Black Diamond Orchestra) which the interview

ctx.x: Where did you all work mostly? Do you remember? Well, we worked on the Pelican.

At that time, the Pelican, the Economy Hall, Autocrat. They did quite a bit of work. Yes. Now, they might have... You might have heard of a band. It was very famous called the Sunny South. Oh, yes. Well, this band was formed. The Sunny South was formed from this band. From that, yes. You had Dajon, Pearson, Montague. I think that was all. Now, they had Richard McLean. He played guitar with them. And the bass player, I just remember who they had on the bass. But this was the band that caused me to fall asleep that…
